scope: Sprint 10 Phase 7 — Victoria supply, demographics, affordability
method: Verification against already-loaded national data (ABS ASGS/Census/Building Approvals, loaded Sprints 2-4 and 9 as national datasets, not NSW-scoped) rather than new ingestion. Confirmed via direct branch query, not assumption.

demographics.note: Same 2016/2021 ASGS boundary-mismatch limitation as NSW applies identically (population_2016 / population_growth_2016_2021_pct remain NULL where the boundary comparison isn't valid) — not a VIC-specific gap.

rba_interest_rate_context.note: National by definition — no state-specific rate exists to source separately.

affordability_methodology.jurisdiction_scoping: none — the assumption table has no jurisdiction/state column, so NSW and VIC snapshots computed from it necessarily share the same deposit_percent (20%), loan_term_years (30), repayment_type (principal_and_interest), rate_source (mart.national_interest_rate_context), and lmi_included (false, excluded) — verified by direct query, not by re-implementing the formula per state.
affordability_methodology.conclusion: No code change needed to guarantee identical methodology across NSW/VIC — this is a structural property of the existing schema, confirmed rather than assumed.
